sentences.en: Being offered the CEO position was a chance of a lifetime for her.
sentences.zh: 獲得執行長的職位對她來說是千載難逢的機會。

sentences.en: He invested in the startup, believing it to be a chance of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 他投資了這家新創公司，相信這是一個千載難逢的機會。

sentences.en: Don't miss out on this scholarship; it is a chance of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 別錯過這個獎學金，這可是千載難逢的機會。

sentences.en: Traveling around the world while working remotely is a chance of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 邊遠距工作邊環遊世界是千載難逢的機會。

sentences.en: They considered the merger a chance of a lifetime to dominate the market.
sentences.zh: 他們認為這次合併是稱霸市場千載難逢的機會。

sentences.en: The door closed with a loud bang, startling everyone in the office.
sentences.zh: 門砰的一聲關上了，嚇到了辦公室裡的所有人。

sentences.en: She accidentally banged her knee against the conference table.
sentences.zh: 她不小心把膝蓋撞到了會議桌上。

sentences.en: The new marketing campaign started with a bang and immediately attracted customers.
sentences.zh: 新的行銷活動一開始就一鳴驚人，立刻吸引了顧客。

sentences.en: We heard a loud bang from the warehouse during the night shift.
sentences.zh: 我們在夜班時聽到倉庫傳來一聲巨響。

sentences.en: Please don't bang the door when you leave the meeting room.
sentences.zh: 離開會議室時請不要砰地關上門。

sentences.en: The dress code requires female employees to wear a white blouse and a dark skirt.
sentences.zh: 服裝規定要求女員工穿著白色上衣和深色裙子。

sentences.en: She bought a silk blouse for the upcoming business conference.
sentences.zh: 她為即將到來的商業會議買了一件絲綢女裝上衣。

sentences.en: The coffee stain on her new blouse was difficult to remove.
sentences.zh: 她新上衣上的咖啡漬很難清除。

sentences.en: Customers have been returning this blouse because of a defect in the zipper.
sentences.zh: 顧客們一直因為拉鍊的瑕疵而退回這款女裝上衣。

sentences.en: Our latest fashion collection features blouses in various pastel colors.
sentences.zh: 我們最新的時尚系列主打各種柔和色彩的女裝上衣。

sentences.en: The firefighter received an award for his outstanding bravery during the rescue.
sentences.zh: 這名消防員因在救援中的傑出勇敢表現而獲獎。

sentences.en: It takes great bravery to admit a mistake and take responsibility for it.
sentences.zh: 承認錯誤並承擔責任需要很大的勇氣。

sentences.en: Her bravery in challenging the unfair company policy was admired by her colleagues.
sentences.zh: 她挑戰不公平公司政策的勇氣受到同事們的欽佩。

sentences.en: The CEO praised the team's bravery in entering a highly competitive market.
sentences.zh: 執行長讚揚了團隊進入高度競爭市場的勇氣。

sentences.en: We must show bravery when facing unprecedented economic difficulties.
sentences.zh: 在面對前所未有的經濟困難時，我們必須展現勇氣。

sentences.en: The construction site is surrounded by orange traffic cones for safety.
sentences.zh: 為了安全起見，建築工地周圍擺滿了橘色交通錐。

sentences.en: She ordered a large scoop of vanilla ice cream in a waffle cone.
sentences.zh: 她點了一大球裝在華夫餅甜筒裡的香草冰淇淋。

sentences.en: The packaging for our new product is shaped like a cone.
sentences.zh: 我們新產品的包裝形狀像一個圓錐體。

sentences.en: During the autumn hike, we collected several pine cones from the forest.
sentences.zh: 在秋季健行時，我們從森林裡收集了幾顆松果。

sentences.en: Please navigate the vehicle carefully around the cones during the driving test.
sentences.zh: 在駕駛考試期間，請小心駕駛車輛繞過交通錐。

sentences.en: The only sound in the quiet countryside was the chirping of a cricket.
sentences.zh: 寧靜鄉村裡唯一的聲音就是蟋蟀的鳴叫聲。

sentences.en: Cricket is a highly popular sport in countries like the UK, Australia, and India.
sentences.zh: 板球在英國、澳洲和印度等國家是非常受歡迎的運動。

sentences.en: Our company decided to sponsor the national cricket team to boost brand visibility.
sentences.zh: 我們公司決定贊助國家板球隊以提升品牌能見度。

sentences.en: When I presented my innovative idea, all I heard were crickets from the board members.
sentences.zh: 當我提出創新想法時，董事會成員一片死寂（毫無反應）。

sentences.en: He has been practicing cricket every weekend since he was a child.
sentences.zh: 他從小就每個週末都在練習板球。

sentences.en: The heavy suitcase was a drag to carry up the stairs without an elevator.
sentences.zh: 沒有電梯的情況下，把沉重的行李箱拖上樓是個累贅。

sentences.en: Please do not drag the chairs across the newly polished floor.
sentences.zh: 請不要在剛打磨過的地板上拖曳椅子。

sentences.en: The ongoing lawsuit has become a major drag on the company's financial growth.
sentences.zh: 持續進行的訴訟已成為公司財務成長的一大阻力。

sentences.en: He had to drag himself out of bed early for the overseas video conference.
sentences.zh: 他不得不早起硬拖著自己起床參加海外視訊會議。

sentences.en: You can simply drag and drop the files into this folder to upload them.
sentences.zh: 您只需將檔案拖放到此資料夾中即可上傳。

sentences.en: The supplier has been dragging its feet on delivering the essential raw materials.
sentences.zh: 供應商在運送關鍵原物料上一直拖拖拉拉。

sentences.en: If management continues to drag their heels, we might lose this client.
sentences.zh: 如果管理層繼續拖延，我們可能會失去這位客戶。

sentences.en: Stop dragging your feet and finish the quarterly report by tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 別再拖延了，明天前完成季度報告。

sentences.en: They dragged their heels in signing the contract because they were unsure about the terms.
sentences.zh: 他們在簽署合約時拖延，因為對條款不確定。

sentences.en: The government is being accused of dragging its feet on environmental regulations.
sentences.zh: 政府被指責在環境法規方面拖延進度。

sentences.en: She prefers to have an egg white omelet for breakfast to maintain a healthy diet.
sentences.zh: 她喜歡早餐吃純蛋白煎蛋捲以保持健康飲食。

sentences.en: Whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form before adding the sugar.
sentences.zh: 在加入糖之前，將蛋白打發至硬挺。

sentences.en: Our bakery uses fresh egg whites to make these delicate macarons.
sentences.zh: 我們的麵包店使用新鮮蛋白來製作這些精緻的馬卡龍。

sentences.en: Egg white is known to be an excellent source of high-quality protein.
sentences.zh: 眾所周知，蛋白是優質蛋白質的極佳來源。

sentences.en: Separate the yolk from the egg white carefully when preparing the dessert.
sentences.zh: 準備這道甜點時，請小心地將蛋黃與蛋白分開。

sentences.en: The annual team-building retreat was highly enjoyable for all the staff members.
sentences.zh: 年度團隊建立靜修活動讓所有員工都感到非常愉快。

sentences.en: Our goal is to make the online shopping experience as enjoyable as possible.
sentences.zh: 我們的目標是讓線上購物體驗盡可能令人愉快。

sentences.en: Despite the long flight, the business trip to Paris turned out to be quite enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 儘管飛行時間很長，這趟巴黎出差證明是相當愉快的。

sentences.en: We had an enjoyable conversation about future collaboration opportunities over lunch.
sentences.zh: 我們在午餐時就未來的合作機會進行了愉快的交談。

sentences.en: The hotel provides various amenities to ensure a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
sentences.zh: 飯店提供各種設施，以確保住宿舒適愉快。

sentences.en: The authorities confiscated thousands of fake luxury watches at the port.
sentences.zh: 當局在港口沒收了數千支偽造的精品手錶。

sentences.en: He was fired after it was discovered that he had used a fake degree on his resume.
sentences.zh: 在被發現履歷上使用了假學歷後，他被解雇了。

sentences.en: Please ensure that the signatures on the contracts are genuine, not fake.
sentences.zh: 請確保合約上的簽名是真實的，而非偽造的。

sentences.en: She had to fake a smile during the frustrating meeting with the clients.
sentences.zh: 在與客戶令人沮喪的會議中，她不得不假裝微笑。

sentences.en: The museum hired experts to verify whether the painting was a masterpiece or a fake.
sentences.zh: 博物館聘請專家來驗證這幅畫是傑作還是贗品。

sentences.en: The sudden appearance of a grasshopper startled the guests at the outdoor cafe.
sentences.zh: 一隻蚱蜢突然出現，嚇到了戶外咖啡館的客人。

sentences.en: In some agricultural regions, grasshoppers can cause severe damage to the crops.
sentences.zh: 在某些農業地區，蚱蜢會對農作物造成嚴重的破壞。

sentences.en: He watched a grasshopper jump from one leaf to another in the garden.
sentences.zh: 他看著花園裡一隻蚱蜢從一片葉子跳到另一片葉子上。

sentences.en: The biology teacher used a grasshopper to explain the anatomy of insects.
sentences.zh: 生物老師用蚱蜢來解釋昆蟲的解剖結構。

sentences.en: During the summer evening, we could hear the sound of grasshoppers in the field.
sentences.zh: 在夏日的傍晚，我們可以聽到田野裡蚱蜢的聲音。

sentences.en: The CEO arrived at the conference with her executive assistant in tow.
sentences.zh: 執行長帶著她的行政助理來到了會議現場。

sentences.en: After the car broke down, it was taken to the mechanic in tow.
sentences.zh: 車子拋錨後，被拖曳到了技工那裡。

sentences.en: The celebrity entered the restaurant with an entire entourage of reporters in tow.
sentences.zh: 這位名人帶著一大群記者尾隨進入了餐廳。

sentences.en: They managed to get the disabled ship back to port safely in tow.
sentences.zh: 他們成功地將失去動力的船隻安全地拖回港口。

sentences.en: She walked into the office with three new interns in tow, ready for training.
sentences.zh: 她帶著三名新實習生走進辦公室，準備進行培訓。

sentences.en: The announcement of the annual bonus brought a joyful atmosphere to the office.
sentences.zh: 年度獎金的發布為辦公室帶來了充滿歡樂的氣氛。

sentences.en: We wish you a joyful holiday season and a prosperous New Year.
sentences.zh: 我們祝您有一個充滿歡樂的假期和繁榮的新年。

sentences.en: The successful product launch was a joyful occasion for the entire development team.
sentences.zh: 成功的產品發布對整個開發團隊來說是一個充滿歡樂的場合。

sentences.en: Employees expressed their joyful anticipation for the upcoming company trip.
sentences.zh: 員工們表達了對即將到來的公司旅行充滿歡樂的期待。

sentences.en: Her joyful personality makes her exceptionally suited for customer service roles.
sentences.zh: 她充滿歡樂的個性讓她特別適合從事客戶服務工作。

sentences.en: The manufacturer offers a lifetime warranty on all its premium products.
sentences.zh: 製造商對其所有頂級產品提供終身保固。

sentences.en: Building a successful global brand is often the work of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 建立一個成功的全球品牌往往是一生努力的成果。

sentences.en: She has accumulated a wealth of knowledge over her lifetime in the industry.
sentences.zh: 她在這個行業的一生中累積了豐富的知識。

sentences.en: This revolutionary technology will undoubtedly change how we work in our lifetime.
sentences.zh: 這項革命性的技術無疑將在我們有生之年改變我們的工作方式。

sentences.en: He achieved more in his short career than most people do in a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 他在短暫的職業生涯中所取得的成就超過了大多數人一生的成就。

sentences.en: The old lighthouse has been renovated and turned into a popular tourist attraction.
sentences.zh: 這座古老的燈塔已經翻修並變成了受歡迎的旅遊景點。

sentences.en: The captain relied on the lighthouse to safely navigate the ship through the storm.
sentences.zh: 船長依靠燈塔在暴風雨中安全地駕駛船隻。

sentences.en: Our company aims to be a lighthouse of innovation in the tech industry.
sentences.zh: 我們公司致力於成為科技產業創新的燈塔。

sentences.en: We enjoyed a beautiful coastal walk that ended near the historic lighthouse.
sentences.zh: 我們享受了一段美麗的海岸漫步，終點在歷史悠久的燈塔附近。

sentences.en: The lighthouse beam was visible for miles, warning sailors of the dangerous rocks.
sentences.zh: 燈塔的光束在數英里外都能看見，警告水手們注意危險的岩石。

sentences.en: We decorated the reception desk with a beautiful vase of white lilies.
sentences.zh: 我們用一瓶美麗的白百合花裝飾了接待處。

sentences.en: The perfume features strong notes of jasmine, rose, and lily.
sentences.zh: 這款香水具有強烈的茉莉、玫瑰和百合花香調。

sentences.en: She received a bouquet of lilies as a congratulatory gift for her promotion.
sentences.zh: 她收到了一束百合花作為升職的祝賀禮物。

sentences.en: The botanical garden has an entire section dedicated to rare species of lily.
sentences.zh: 植物園有一個專門展示稀有百合花品種的區域。

sentences.en: The floral pattern on the new wallpaper design heavily incorporates the lily.
sentences.zh: 新壁紙設計的圖案大量融入了百合花元素。

sentences.en: The workplace accident resulted in the unfortunate loss of a limb for the worker.
sentences.zh: 這起工安意外不幸導致該名工人失去了一肢。

sentences.en: The company went out on a limb to invest in the unproven technology.
sentences.zh: 公司冒著極大風險（孤注一擲）投資了這項未經證實的技術。

sentences.en: After the long marathon, my limbs felt completely exhausted and sore.
sentences.zh: 在漫長的馬拉松之後，我的四肢感到完全疲憊和痠痛。

sentences.en: The falling tree limb severely damaged the power lines near our office building.
sentences.zh: 掉落的樹枝嚴重損壞了我們辦公大樓附近的電線。

sentences.en: Physical therapy helped him gradually regain full movement in his injured limbs.
sentences.zh: 物理治療幫助他逐漸恢復了受傷四肢的全部活動能力。

sentences.en: The pediatrician always gives a lollipop to the kids after their check-up.
sentences.zh: 小兒科醫生總是在檢查後給孩子們一根棒棒糖。

sentences.en: We distributed promotional lollipops with our company logo at the trade show.
sentences.zh: 我們在貿易展上發放印有我們公司標誌的宣傳棒棒糖。

sentences.en: The candy store introduced a new line of gourmet lollipops featuring exotic flavors.
sentences.zh: 糖果店推出了一系列具有異國風味的高級棒棒糖。

sentences.en: Sales of lollipops and other sweets peak significantly during the Halloween season.
sentences.zh: 棒棒糖和其他糖果的銷售在萬聖節期間達到高峰。

sentences.en: The little boy accidentally dropped his lollipop on the ground and started crying.
sentences.zh: 小男孩不小心把棒棒糖掉在地上，開始哭了起來。

sentences.en: Several important files are missing from the shared company drive.
sentences.zh: 公司共享雲端硬碟中有幾個重要檔案不見了。

sentences.en: The airline apologized for the missing luggage and promised to locate it soon.
sentences.zh: 航空公司為遺失的行李道歉，並承諾會盡快找到。

sentences.en: If any components are missing from the package, please contact customer support immediately.
sentences.zh: 如果包裝中有任何零件遺漏，請立即聯絡客服。

sentences.en: The manager noticed that three key figures were missing from the financial report.
sentences.zh: 經理注意到財務報告中遺漏了三個關鍵數據。

sentences.en: A search operation was launched to find the hikers who went missing in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 搜救行動已經展開，以尋找在山區失蹤的登山客。

sentences.en: His colleagues gave him the nickname 'The Wizard' because of his coding skills.
sentences.zh: 他的同事因為他的程式設計技巧而給他取了個綽號叫「巫師」。

sentences.en: The city of Chicago is widely known by its nickname, the Windy City.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥市以其綽號「風城」而廣為人知。

sentences.en: She doesn't like being called by her childhood nickname in a professional setting.
sentences.zh: 她不喜歡在專業場合被叫她童年時的小名。

sentences.en: They affectionately nicknamed the new automated robot in the warehouse 'Speedy'.
sentences.zh: 他們親切地將倉庫裡的新型自動化機器人取了個綽號叫「Speedy」。

sentences.en: Using a nickname on official legal documents is generally not permitted.
sentences.zh: 在正式法律文件上通常不允許使用綽號。

sentences.en: The delivery company uses bubble wrap to pad fragile items during shipping.
sentences.zh: 快遞公司在運送過程中使用氣泡紙來填塞保護易碎物品。

sentences.en: He jotted down the meeting notes on a small writing pad he kept in his pocket.
sentences.zh: 他將會議記錄寫在放在口袋裡的小記事本上。

sentences.en: The dog injured the soft pad of its paw while running on the rough concrete.
sentences.zh: 那隻狗在粗糙的混凝土上奔跑時，傷到了腳掌的軟墊。

sentences.en: Make sure you wear knee pads when participating in this extreme sport.
sentences.zh: 參加這項極限運動時，請務必戴上護膝（護墊）。

sentences.en: The pharmacy stocks a wide variety of sanitary pads and related products.
sentences.zh: 藥局備有種類繁多的衛生棉及相關產品。

sentences.en: The doctor prescribed a new pain relief pill for his chronic backache.
sentences.zh: 醫生為他的慢性背痛開了一種新的止痛藥丸。

sentences.en: Please remember to take the pill with a full glass of water after meals.
sentences.zh: 請記得在飯後配一大杯水服下這顆藥丸。

sentences.en: The pharmaceutical company is developing a revolutionary pill to treat the disease.
sentences.zh: 這家製藥公司正在開發一種治療該疾病的革命性藥丸。

sentences.en: Finding out about the sudden budget cuts was a bitter pill to swallow.
sentences.zh: 得知突然削減預算的消息是一個難以接受的事實（苦果）。

sentences.en: She forgot to pack her sleeping pills for the international business trip.
sentences.zh: 她忘了在國際出差時帶上安眠藥。

sentences.en: All employees must punch in their time cards before entering the factory floor.
sentences.zh: 所有員工在進入廠房前都必須打卡上下班。

sentences.en: Use the hole punch to prepare these documents for the binder.
sentences.zh: 使用打孔機在這些文件上打洞以便裝訂。

sentences.en: The new advertising campaign really packs a punch and grabs attention instantly.
sentences.zh: 新的廣告宣傳活動非常有震撼力，立刻吸引了人們的注意。

sentences.en: At the company holiday party, we served fruit punch along with other beverages.
sentences.zh: 在公司的節日派對上，我們提供了綜合果汁（潘趣酒）和其他飲料。

sentences.en: He was suspended after attempting to punch a coworker during an argument.
sentences.zh: 他在爭吵中試圖用拳猛擊同事後被停職了。

sentences.en: The machine started making a queer noise right before the entire system shut down.
sentences.zh: 就在整個系統關閉之前，機器開始發出奇特的噪音。

sentences.en: He had a queer feeling that they were being watched by the competitors.
sentences.zh: 他有一種古怪的感覺，覺得他們正被競爭對手監視著。

sentences.en: The software glitch produced some rather queer results in the financial forecasting model.
sentences.zh: 軟體故障在財務預測模型中產生了一些相當奇特的結果。

sentences.en: It is queer how the client abruptly canceled the multi-million dollar contract without explanation.
sentences.zh: 客戶突然毫無解釋地取消了數百萬美元的合約，這真是古怪。

sentences.en: She gave me a queer look when I suggested completely changing our marketing strategy.
sentences.zh: 當我建議徹底改變我們的行銷策略時，她給了我一個古怪的眼神。

sentences.en: We decided to have a traditional Sunday roast to celebrate the successful merger.
sentences.zh: 我們決定吃一頓傳統的週日烤肉來慶祝合併成功。

sentences.en: The local cafe prides itself on using freshly roasted coffee beans.
sentences.zh: 這家當地咖啡館以使用新鮮烘焙（烤）的咖啡豆為傲。

sentences.en: You need to roast the vegetables for at least forty minutes in the oven.
sentences.zh: 你需要將蔬菜在烤箱裡烤至少四十分鐘。

sentences.en: As a team-building activity, we organized a comedy roast for the retiring director.
sentences.zh: 作為團隊建立活動，我們為即將退休的總監舉辦了一場喜劇吐槽大會（roast）。

sentences.en: The chef prepared a beautifully seasoned roast beef for the corporate banquet.
sentences.zh: 主廚為企業宴會準備了一道調味精美的烤牛肉。

sentences.en: During the economic crisis, investment capital became extremely scarce for startups.
sentences.zh: 在經濟危機期間，新創公司的投資資金變得極度缺乏。

sentences.en: Clean water is a scarce resource in many developing regions of the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界上許多發展中地區，乾淨的水是一種稀缺資源。

sentences.en: Skilled IT professionals remain scarce in the current competitive job market.
sentences.zh: 在當前競爭激烈的就業市場中，熟練的資訊科技專業人員仍然很缺乏。

sentences.en: Historical artifacts of this particular era are scarce and highly valuable to collectors.
sentences.zh: 這個特定時代的歷史文物非常罕見，對收藏家來說極具價值。

sentences.en: We must act quickly, as opportunities like this are very scarce.
sentences.zh: 我們必須迅速採取行動，因為這樣的機會非常罕見。

sentences.en: She wore a thick woolen scarf to protect herself from the freezing wind.
sentences.zh: 她戴著厚厚的羊毛圍巾來保護自己免受刺骨寒風的侵襲。

sentences.en: The luxury brand's signature silk scarf is highly popular among our VIP clients.
sentences.zh: 這個奢侈品牌的標誌性絲綢圍巾在我們的貴賓客戶中非常受歡迎。

sentences.en: I left my winter scarf in the taxi on my way to the corporate headquarters.
sentences.zh: 在前往企業總部的路上，我把冬季圍巾忘在計程車上了。

sentences.en: He loosened his scarf and unbuttoned his coat as soon as he entered the heated building.
sentences.zh: 他一進到有暖氣的建築物裡，就鬆開了圍巾並解開了外套的釦子。

sentences.en: The company gifted a custom-designed scarf to all employees for the anniversary.
sentences.zh: 公司在週年紀念日向所有員工贈送了一條客製化設計的圍巾。

sentences.en: The recent drop in our stock price is a scary indicator for future profitability.
sentences.zh: 我們最近股價的下跌對未來獲利能力來說是一個可怕的指標。

sentences.en: It can be scary to start a new business venture without any prior experience.
sentences.zh: 在沒有任何先前經驗的情況下開始新的創業可能會很嚇人。

sentences.en: The financial audit revealed some scary inconsistencies in the accounting records.
sentences.zh: 財務審計揭露了會計記錄中一些可怕的不一致之處。

sentences.en: We watched a scary movie during the Halloween party hosted by the HR department.
sentences.zh: 在人力資源部舉辦的萬聖節派對上，我們看了一部嚇人的電影。

sentences.en: Facing the board of directors to explain the project failure was a scary experience.
sentences.zh: 面對董事會解釋專案失敗是一次可怕的經歷。

sentences.en: The talent agency sent a scout to the university to recruit promising graduates.
sentences.zh: 這家人才機構派了一名星探（偵查員）到大學招募有前途的畢業生。

sentences.en: We need to scout the area carefully before deciding where to build the new factory.
sentences.zh: 在決定在哪裡建立新工廠之前，我們需要仔細偵察該地區。

sentences.en: As a boy scout, he learned many outdoor survival skills that built his character.
sentences.zh: 身為一名童子軍，他學到了許多塑造他性格的戶外求生技能。

sentences.en: The manager is currently scouting for potential locations to open our next retail branch.
sentences.zh: 經理目前正在四處搜尋適合開設我們下一家零售分店的地點。

sentences.en: Our competitors are actively scouting our top engineers and trying to poach them.
sentences.zh: 我們的競爭對手正在積極偵察我們的頂尖工程師並試圖挖角。

sentences.en: He took a slow sip of his coffee while reviewing the latest sales data.
sentences.zh: 他在查看最新銷售數據時，慢慢啜飲了一口咖啡。

sentences.en: It is polite to just sip the wine rather than drinking it quickly during a business dinner.
sentences.zh: 在商務晚宴上，只啜飲葡萄酒而不是一飲而盡是有禮貌的表現。

sentences.en: She offered him a sip of the newly developed beverage to get his immediate feedback.
sentences.zh: 她請他吸一口新研發的飲料，以獲得他的即時回饋。

sentences.en: The client casually sipped his tea as we presented the project proposal.
sentences.zh: 當我們提出專案企劃案時，客戶漫不經心地啜飲著他的茶。

sentences.en: Please don't sip your drink so loudly; it's distracting during the meeting.
sentences.zh: 請不要喝得那麼大聲；這在會議期間會讓人分心。

sentences.en: The company managed to secure a larger slice of the global market share this year.
sentences.zh: 該公司今年成功獲得了更大的全球市場份額（一片）。

sentences.en: Could you please cut a thin slice of lemon to put in my iced tea?
sentences.zh: 可以請您切一片薄檸檬片放在我的冰茶裡嗎？

sentences.en: Every department is fighting for a slice of the newly allocated budget.
sentences.zh: 每個部門都在爭奪新分配預算的一部份（一片）。

sentences.en: He ate a slice of pizza at his desk while working late to meet the deadline.
sentences.zh: 為了趕上截止日期而加班時，他在辦公桌前吃了一片披薩。

sentences.en: The bakery sells this artisanal bread by the slice for customer convenience.
sentences.zh: 為了方便顧客，這家麵包店按片出售這種手工麵包。

sentences.en: The chemical spill in the laboratory caused an immediate evacuation of the building.
sentences.zh: 實驗室的化學品溢出導致整棟大樓立即疏散。

sentences.en: Be careful not to spill your coffee on the important legal documents.
sentences.zh: 小心別把咖啡灑在重要的法律文件上。

sentences.en: The oil spill had a devastating environmental impact on the coastal communities.
sentences.zh: 這次漏油（溢出物）事件對沿海社區造成了毀滅性的環境影響。

sentences.en: She accidentally spilled the beans about the confidential merger before the official announcement.
sentences.zh: 她在正式宣布前不小心洩漏了關於機密合併的消息。

sentences.en: The cleaning staff was called to wipe up a water spill near the main elevator.
sentences.zh: 清潔人員被叫去擦拭主電梯附近的積水（溢出物）。

sentences.en: The passing truck drove through a puddle and splashed muddy water all over my suit.
sentences.zh: 路過的卡車開過水坑，把泥水濺了我一身西裝。

sentences.en: The new product launch made a big splash in the consumer electronics market.
sentences.zh: 新產品的發表在消費性電子市場引起了巨大迴響（濺起水花）。

sentences.en: I heard a loud splash and realized someone had fallen into the swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 我聽到一聲巨大的濺水聲，這才意識到有人掉進了游泳池。

sentences.en: To wake himself up before the morning meeting, he splashed cold water on his face.
sentences.zh: 為了在晨會前讓自己清醒，他在臉上潑了冷水。

sentences.en: The advertisement features a refreshing splash of fruit juice to attract buyers.
sentences.zh: 這則廣告以清爽的果汁飛濺畫面來吸引買家。

sentences.en: The company experienced a steep decline in profits during the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 該公司在第三季度的利潤經歷了急劇的（陡峭的）下降。

sentences.en: The learning curve for this complex software is exceptionally steep for beginners.
sentences.zh: 對於初學者來說，這個複雜軟體的學習曲線異常陡峭。

sentences.en: We had to climb a steep hill to reach the site of the new telecommunications tower.
sentences.zh: 我們必須爬上一個陡峭的山丘才能到達新電信塔的地點。

sentences.en: Their prices are quite steep compared to what other vendors are offering.
sentences.zh: 與其他供應商提供的價格相比，他們的價格相當高昂（陡峭）。

sentences.en: The proposed tax increase will have a steep impact on small business owners.
sentences.zh: 擬議中的增稅將對小企業主產生巨大的（陡峭的）影響。

sentences.en: The new industrial park is situated on a gentle slope, providing excellent drainage for the facilities.
sentences.zh: 新的工業園區位於緩坡上，為設施提供了極佳的排水系統。

sentences.en: Investors were warned about the steep slope in the market's recovery, indicating potential risks ahead.
sentences.zh: 投資者被警告市場復甦面臨陡坡，這表明未來存在潛在風險。

sentences.en: Due to the steep slope of the road leading to the warehouse, delivery trucks often experience delays.
sentences.zh: 由於通往倉庫的道路有陡坡，送貨卡車經常會遇到延遲。

sentences.en: The architect suggested building a ramp with a gentle slope to accommodate employees using wheelchairs.
sentences.zh: 建築師建議建造一個坡度平緩的坡道，以方便使用輪椅的員工。

sentences.en: Navigating the steep slope of regulatory changes requires a dedicated legal compliance team.
sentences.zh: 應對監管變化的陡坡需要一個專職的法律合規團隊。

sentences.en: The sudden cancellation of the contract stung the company's financial projections for the quarter.
sentences.zh: 合約的突然取消使公司本季度的財務預測受到了打擊。

sentences.en: Be careful when inspecting the outdoor equipment, as there have been reports of bee stings in the area.
sentences.zh: 檢查戶外設備時要小心，因為該地區已有蜜蜂螫傷的報告。

sentences.en: The sharp criticism from the board members stung the CEO, prompting him to revise the business strategy.
sentences.zh: 董事會成員的尖銳批評刺痛了執行長，促使他修改了商業策略。

sentences.en: Applying this antiseptic ointment will help reduce the pain and swelling from the insect sting.
sentences.zh: 塗抹這種抗菌軟膏將有助於減輕昆蟲螫傷引起的疼痛和腫脹。

sentences.en: They felt the sting of defeat after losing the bid to a major competitor in the final round.
sentences.zh: 在最後一輪競標中輸給主要競爭對手後，他們嚐到了失敗的痛苦。

sentences.en: The tailor carefully added a final stitch to the custom-made suit before delivering it to the executive.
sentences.zh: 裁縫在將訂製西裝交付給高管之前，仔細地縫上了最後一針。

sentences.en: After the workplace accident, the employee required several stitches on his arm at the local hospital.
sentences.zh: 在工作場所發生意外後，該名員工在當地醫院的手臂上縫了幾針。

sentences.en: We need to stitch these disparate marketing strategies together to form a cohesive global campaign.
sentences.zh: 我們需要將這些截然不同的行銷策略縫合在一起，形成一個具凝聚力的全球活動。

sentences.en: The defective garments were returned to the factory because the stitching on the seams was coming undone.
sentences.zh: 由於接縫處的縫線鬆脫，有瑕疵的服裝被退回了工廠。

sentences.en: Her presentation was stitched together seamlessly, combining financial data with compelling market research.
sentences.zh: 她的簡報完美地串聯在一起，將財務數據與引人注目的市場研究結合起來。

sentences.en: The CEO navigated the company through a stormy period of economic recession and declining sales.
sentences.zh: 執行長帶領公司度過了經濟衰退和銷售額下降的風雨飄搖時期。

sentences.en: Due to the stormy weather conditions, all flights to the regional headquarters have been temporarily grounded.
sentences.zh: 由於暴風雨天氣，所有飛往區域總部的航班均已暫時停飛。

sentences.en: The negotiation turned into a stormy debate when the topic of salary reductions was introduced.
sentences.zh: 當引進減薪的話題時，談判變成了一場激烈的辯論。

sentences.en: Despite the stormy relationship between the two departments, they managed to complete the project on time.
sentences.zh: 儘管這兩個部門之間的關係緊張，他們還是設法按時完成了專案。

sentences.en: Investors should brace themselves for a stormy week in the stock market following the unexpected election results.
sentences.zh: 在出人意料的選舉結果公佈後，投資者應準備好迎接股市激烈動盪的一週。

sentences.en: The vacuum pump is designed to suck the air out of the packaging to ensure the food remains fresh.
sentences.zh: 真空幫浦的設計是將包裝內的空氣抽出，以確保食品保持新鮮。

sentences.en: Many employees feel that the new administrative procedures just suck up valuable time without adding efficiency.
sentences.zh: 許多員工認為新的行政程序只是浪費了寶貴的時間，卻沒有提高效率。

sentences.en: To be honest, the initial prototype of our software really sucked, but we have made significant improvements since then.
sentences.zh: 老實說，我們軟體的最初原型真的很糟，但從那時起我們已做出了重大改進。

sentences.en: The unexpected taxes will suck a large portion of our quarterly profits, affecting our expansion plans.
sentences.zh: 出乎意料的稅收將吸走我們本季度利潤的很大一部分，影響我們的擴張計畫。

sentences.en: During the brainstorming session, he was sucking on a piece of candy while contemplating the design flaws.
sentences.zh: 在腦力激盪會議期間，他一邊吸吮著糖果，一邊思考著設計缺陷。

sentences.en: The fraudulent investment scheme was specifically designed to prey on unsuspecting suckers looking for quick returns.
sentences.zh: 這個詐欺性投資計畫專門設計來掠奪那些尋求快速回報且毫無戒心的容易上當者。

sentences.en: I must admit I am a sucker for innovative tech gadgets, which is why I always buy the latest models.
sentences.zh: 我必須承認我對創新的科技小工具有著無法抗拒的喜愛，這就是為什麼我總是買最新型號。

sentences.en: He felt like a complete sucker when he realized the "exclusive deal" was actually available to everyone.
sentences.zh: 當他意識到這個「獨家優惠」其實每個人都能享有時，他覺得自己完全是個容易上當的傻瓜。

sentences.en: The salesman tried to convince us that the premium package was necessary, but we were not going to be suckers.
sentences.zh: 推銷員試圖說服我們尊榮方案是必要的，但我們不打算當冤大頭。

sentences.en: As a manager, you cannot be a sucker for every excuse an employee gives for being late to work.
sentences.zh: 身為經理，你不能輕易相信員工上班遲到的每一個藉口。

sentences.en: The doctor prescribed a new type of tablet that should be taken twice a day after meals.
sentences.zh: 醫生開了一種新型藥錠，應在飯後每天服用兩次。

sentences.en: Many sales representatives now prefer using a tablet to showcase product catalogs to potential clients.
sentences.zh: 現在許多銷售代表更喜歡使用平板電腦向潛在客戶展示產品目錄。

sentences.en: Please ensure that the water purification tablet has completely dissolved before drinking from the container.
sentences.zh: 從容器中飲水之前，請確保淨水藥片已完全溶解。

sentences.en: Our company has developed a coating for the tablet that makes it easier for patients to swallow.
sentences.zh: 我們公司為該藥錠開發了一種塗層，使患者更容易吞嚥。

sentences.en: The survey results indicated that most teenagers use a tablet for both educational and entertainment purposes.
sentences.zh: 調查結果表明，大多數青少年將平板電腦用於教育和娛樂目的。

sentences.en: The new manager's primary objective is to tame the chaotic workflow that has plagued the production department.
sentences.zh: 新經理的首要目標是馴服一直困擾生產部門的混亂工作流程。

sentences.en: Inflation has proven difficult to tame, despite the central bank's aggressive interest rate hikes.
sentences.zh: 儘管央行積極升息，但事實證明通貨膨脹難以控制。

sentences.en: Compared to his previous wild predictions, the analyst's latest economic forecast is rather tame.
sentences.zh: 與他之前瘋狂的預測相比，這位分析師最新的經濟預測相當溫和。

sentences.en: The software is designed to tame large datasets, making it easier for marketers to extract actionable insights.
sentences.zh: 該軟體旨在處理龐大的數據集，使行銷人員更容易提取可操作的見解。

sentences.en: It took months of patient training to tame the rescue dogs so they could be adopted by loving families.
sentences.zh: 經過幾個月耐心的訓練才馴服了這些救援犬，以便讓有愛的家庭收養牠們。

sentences.en: We are extremely thankful for your continued partnership and support throughout this challenging fiscal year.
sentences.zh: 我們非常感謝您在這個充滿挑戰的會計年度中持續的合作與支持。

sentences.en: The passengers were thankful that the pilot managed to land the plane safely despite the severe turbulence.
sentences.zh: 乘客們感到慶幸，儘管遇到了嚴重的亂流，飛行員還是設法讓飛機安全降落。

sentences.en: I am thankful to have a team of dedicated professionals who are willing to work overtime to meet deadlines.
sentences.zh: 我很慶幸擁有一支敬業的專業團隊，他們願意加班以趕上截止日期。

sentences.en: She gave a thankful smile when her colleagues surprised her with a farewell gift on her last day.
sentences.zh: 當她的同事在她工作的最後一天給她一份驚喜的告別禮物時，她露出了感激的微笑。

sentences.en: The company is thankful for the prompt response from the IT department during the unexpected server outage.
sentences.zh: 公司感謝資訊科技部門在伺服器意外中斷期間做出的迅速反應。

sentences.en: Managing customer complaints can often feel like a thankless task, but it is crucial for our brand's reputation.
sentences.zh: 處理客戶投訴通常讓人覺得是一件吃力不討好的工作，但這對我們品牌的聲譽至關重要。

sentences.en: He spent hours organizing the archives, a thankless job that went entirely unnoticed by the senior management.
sentences.zh: 他花了幾個小時整理檔案，這是一份完全被高層管理人員忽視且吃力不討好的工作。

sentences.en: It is frustrating to deal with thankless clients who constantly demand more without acknowledging our efforts.
sentences.zh: 應付那些不斷提出更多要求卻不認可我們努力、不知感恩的客戶，令人感到沮喪。

sentences.en: Being the compliance officer is sometimes a thankless position, as you always have to enforce strict rules.
sentences.zh: 擔任合規主管有時是一個吃力不討好的職位，因為你總是必須執行嚴格的規定。

sentences.en: The volunteer coordinator emphasized that even thankless tasks are essential for the charity event's overall success.
sentences.zh: 志工協調員強調，即使是吃力不討好的任務，對於慈善活動的整體成功也是必不可少的。

sentences.en: The entrepreneur's unquenchable thirst for innovation drove him to launch three successful startups in five years.
sentences.zh: 這位企業家對創新的強烈渴望驅使他在五年內創辦了三家成功的初創公司。

sentences.en: After presenting at the conference for two hours straight, he developed a terrible thirst and drank two bottles of water.
sentences.zh: 在連續演講了兩個小時後，他感到非常口渴，喝了兩瓶水。

sentences.en: The corporate training program is designed to satisfy the employees' thirst for professional development.
sentences.zh: 企業培訓計畫旨在滿足員工對專業發展的渴望。

sentences.en: Prolonged exposure to the sun during the site inspection caused severe thirst among the engineering team.
sentences.zh: 在現場視察期間長時間暴露在陽光下，導致工程團隊感到嚴重的口渴。

sentences.en: A true leader must possess a thirst for knowledge and a willingness to continuously adapt to market changes.
sentences.zh: 真正的領導者必須對知識有渴望，並願意不斷適應市場的變化。

sentences.en: The marketing department is thirsty for fresh ideas to revitalize our upcoming winter advertising campaign.
sentences.zh: 行銷部門渴望獲得新鮮的點子，以為我們即將到來的冬季廣告活動注入活力。

sentences.en: We provided bottled water in the reception area for any clients who might be thirsty after their journey.
sentences.zh: 我們在接待區提供瓶裝水，供旅途後可能口渴的客戶飲用。

sentences.en: Investors are thirsty for higher yields in this environment of unprecedentedly low interest rates.
sentences.zh: 在前所未有的低利率環境下，投資者熱切渴望更高的殖利率。

sentences.en: The marathon runners grabbed cups of sports drink from the volunteers as they were extremely thirsty.
sentences.zh: 馬拉松選手從志工那裡接過一杯杯運動飲料，因為他們非常口渴。

sentences.en: Our new recruitment strategy targets young professionals who are thirsty for career advancement opportunities.
sentences.zh: 我們新的招募策略針對的是那些渴望獲得職業晉升機會的年輕專業人士。

sentences.en: The port authority used a specialized tugboat to tow the massive cargo ship into the designated dock.
sentences.zh: 港務局使用專門的拖船將這巨大的貨船拖入指定的碼頭。

sentences.en: If you park your vehicle in the reserved executive spots, building security will have it towed at your expense.
sentences.zh: 如果您將車輛停在保留給高管的車位，大樓保全將會將其拖吊，費用由您承擔。

sentences.en: The damaged company van is currently in tow and will arrive at the repair shop within the hour.
sentences.zh: 損壞的公司廂型車目前正在被拖吊中，將在一小時內到達修理廠。

sentences.en: They had to tow the broken generator out of the basement using a heavy-duty winch.
sentences.zh: 他們必須使用重型絞盤將損壞的發電機從地下室拖出來。

sentences.en: After the engine failure on the highway, we had no choice but to call for a tow to the nearest service station.
sentences.zh: 在高速公路上發生引擎故障後，我們別無選擇，只能叫拖車拖到最近的服務站。

sentences.en: The logistics manager dispatched a tow truck immediately when the delivery van broke down on the interstate.
sentences.zh: 當送貨廂型車在州際公路上拋錨時，物流經理立即派出了一輛拖吊車。

sentences.en: You need to call a tow truck to remove the unauthorized vehicle blocking the entrance to our loading dock.
sentences.zh: 你需要叫一輛拖吊車來移走擋住我們裝卸碼頭入口的未經授權車輛。

sentences.en: The tow truck driver carefully secured the disabled electric vehicle to prevent any damage to its battery pack.
sentences.zh: 拖吊車司機小心地固定好這輛故障的電動車，以防止其電池組受到任何損壞。

sentences.en: Operating a tow truck requires a special commercial driver's license and extensive safety training.
sentences.zh: 駕駛拖吊車需要特殊的商業駕照和廣泛的安全訓練。

sentences.en: Because of the severe snowstorm, all local tow trucks were fully booked for the entire weekend.
sentences.zh: 由於嚴重的暴風雪，當地所有的拖吊車在整個週末都被預訂滿了。

sentences.en: During the audit, employees are expected to provide truthful answers regarding their departmental expenditures.
sentences.zh: 在稽核期間，期望員工對於他們部門的支出提供誠實的回答。

sentences.en: The press release was lauded for being a truthful account of the challenges the company faced last quarter.
sentences.zh: 這份新聞稿因真實記述了公司上個季度面臨的挑戰而受到讚賞。

sentences.en: It is imperative that all information submitted on the loan application form is entirely truthful and accurate.
sentences.zh: 在貸款申請表上提交的所有資訊都必須完全誠實且準確，這一點至關重要。

sentences.en: A truthful assessment of our current market position shows that we are losing ground to smaller startups.
sentences.zh: 對我們當前市場地位的真實評估表明，我們正將優勢讓給較小的初創企業。

sentences.en: The candidate's truthful explanation about a gap in his resume actually impressed the hiring manager.
sentences.zh: 這位求職者對他履歷中空窗期的誠實解釋，實際上給招募經理留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: To create a welcoming atmosphere, the receptionist placed a beautiful crystal vase filled with fresh lilies on the front desk.
sentences.zh: 為了營造熱情的氛圍，接待員在前台放了一個裝滿新鮮百合的美麗水晶花瓶。

sentences.en: The antique porcelain vase displayed in the boardroom was gifted to the founder by an overseas client.
sentences.zh: 展示在董事會議室裡的古董瓷花瓶是一位海外客戶送給創始人的禮物。

sentences.en: During the office move, special care must be taken when packing the fragile glass vase to prevent any breakage.
sentences.zh: 在辦公室搬遷期間，包裝易碎的玻璃花瓶時必須特別小心，以免破裂。

sentences.en: The interior designer selected a tall, minimalist vase to complement the modern aesthetic of the executive suite.
sentences.zh: 室內設計師選擇了一個高大、極簡主義的花瓶，以搭配行政套房的現代美學。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the cleaning staff accidentally knocked over the vase, spilling water all over the important documents.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，清潔人員不小心打翻了花瓶，把水灑在了重要文件上。

sentences.en: All warehouse personnel are required to wear a high-visibility reflective vest for safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 基於安全考量，所有倉庫人員都必須穿著高能見度的反光背心。

sentences.en: The new employee benefits package includes company stock options that will vest after three years of continuous service.
sentences.zh: 新的員工福利方案包括公司股票選擇權，這些選擇權將在連續服務三年後歸屬(生效)。

sentences.en: He wore a customized vest featuring the company logo during the trade show to promote brand awareness.
sentences.zh: 在貿易展期間，他穿了一件印有公司標誌的客製化背心，以提升品牌知名度。

sentences.en: The CEO typically wears a tailored suit with a matching vest when attending formal shareholder meetings.
sentences.zh: 執行長在參加正式的股東會議時，通常會穿著一套量身訂製的西裝搭配相配的背心。

sentences.en: Before the construction tour began, the project manager handed each investor a hard hat and a safety vest.
sentences.zh: 在施工參觀開始之前，專案經理遞給每位投資者一頂安全帽和一件安全背心。

sentences.en: The marketing team chose a vibrant violet hue for the new product packaging to make it stand out on the shelves.
sentences.zh: 行銷團隊為新產品包裝選擇了鮮豔的紫羅蘭色，使其在貨架上脫穎而出。

sentences.en: She received a bouquet of violets from a satisfied client as a token of appreciation for her excellent service.
sentences.zh: 她收到了一位滿意客戶送的一束紫羅蘭，以感謝她出色的服務。

sentences.en: The corporate event featured elegant centerpieces with white roses and delicate violet accents.
sentences.zh: 這場企業活動的特色是優雅的桌飾，以白玫瑰和精緻的紫羅蘭色作點綴。

sentences.en: We noticed a subtle violet tint in the printing proofs, which needs to be corrected before mass production.
sentences.zh: 我們注意到印刷打樣中有輕微的紫羅蘭色調，這需要在量產前進行修正。

sentences.en: The laboratory uses ultra-violet light to sterilize the equipment, ensuring a contaminant-free environment.
sentences.zh: 實驗室使用紫外線對設備進行消毒，確保環境無污染。

sentences.en: The chef carefully separated the egg yolk from the white to prepare the rich sauce for the VIP dinner.
sentences.zh: 廚師小心地將蛋黃與蛋白分開，為貴賓晚宴準備濃郁的醬汁。

sentences.en: This new food processing machine can automatically extract the yolk at a rate of two thousand eggs per hour.
sentences.zh: 這台新型食品加工機可以自動提取蛋黃，速度達每小時兩千個雞蛋。

sentences.en: The bakery sources organic eggs with deep orange yolks to enhance the color and flavor of their premium pastries.
sentences.zh: 這家麵包店採購蛋黃呈深橘色的有機雞蛋，以增強其高級糕點的顏色和風味。

sentences.en: Nutritional studies highlight that the yolk contains essential vitamins and minerals, which we use in our health supplements.
sentences.zh: 營養學研究強調蛋黃含有必需的維生素和礦物質，我們將其用於我們的健康補充劑中。

sentences.en: The quality control team rejected the batch because the yolks were breaking too easily during the automated mixing process.
sentences.zh: 品質管制團隊拒絕了這批貨，因為在自動攪拌過程中蛋黃太容易破裂。

sentences.en: Please make sure to zip the protective casing of the equipment before transporting it to the off-site location.
sentences.zh: 在將設備運送到異地之前，請確保拉上設備保護殼的拉鍊。

sentences.en: The assistant was asked to zip the digital files into a single folder so they could be easily emailed to the client.
sentences.zh: 助理被要求將數位檔案壓縮成一個資料夾，以便輕鬆透過電子郵件發送給客戶。

sentences.en: He quickly zipped up his jacket as he rushed out of the office into the cold winter wind to catch a taxi.
sentences.zh: 他匆忙跑出辦公室，衝進寒冷的冬風中去搭計程車時，迅速拉上了夾克的拉鍊。

sentences.en: The new courier service promises to zip your packages across the city in less than two hours.
sentences.zh: 新的快遞服務承諾在不到兩小時內將您的包裹快速送達整個城市。

sentences.en: Before entering the cleanroom facility, all technicians must fully zip their protective suits to maintain sterility.
sentences.zh: 在進入無塵室設施之前，所有技術人員必須將防護衣的拉鍊完全拉上，以保持無菌狀態。

sentences.en: The manufacturing company recalled the travel bags because the main zipper was prone to breaking under heavy loads.
sentences.zh: 這家製造公司召回了這些旅行袋，因為主拉鍊在重載下容易斷裂。

sentences.en: Our new line of outdoor gear features a waterproof zipper that protects electronic devices in harsh weather.
sentences.zh: 我們新系列的戶外裝備採用了防水拉鍊，可以在惡劣天氣下保護電子設備。

sentences.en: The tailor replaced the broken zipper on the executive's briefcase right before his important business trip.
sentences.zh: 裁縫在高管重要的商務旅行之前，更換了他公事包上壞掉的拉鍊。

sentences.en: During the quality inspection, we ensure that every zipper glides smoothly without snagging the surrounding fabric.
sentences.zh: 在品質檢查期間，我們確保每條拉鍊都能平滑滑動，而不會勾住周圍的布料。

sentences.en: The supplier has agreed to lower the unit cost for the brass zippers if we increase our bulk order volume.
sentences.zh: 如果我們增加大量訂購的數量，供應商已同意降低黃銅拉鍊的單位成本。
